Implement the following change in this repository, with tests, following .github/copilot-instructions.md.

release 22: group-only admin console and novice deployment-day guide

The admin console manages Entra groups only; legacy project pages and classification controls are removed (ADR-0054), with server support for older deployments unchanged. Adds a timed deployment-day guide, a decision-led configuration page with a complete HA example, developer and fleet onboarding, and pseudonymised captures of real runs. Staged deployment accepts JSON integer circuit-breaker ranges and Stage 8 checks the charged group exactly.
